The annual securities report cites factors including a shortfall against expected new member acquisition, which reduced the number of members, and higher advertising expenses accompanying the expansion of business scale. entries.4643ca0fecdb3819: According to the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]], the company mainly offers “airCloset,” a monthly subscription service that rents clothing selected by stylists to suit each customer’s preferences and delivers it to the homes of women living in Japan. It is a business structure that procures clothing, adds value through personal styling, and earns revenue from rental usage fees and sales revenue from purchases (buyout fees). Customers can have the next item sent after returning the one they have worn, and can also purchase clothing they like. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its only business segment is the Personal Styling Business. For the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue was ¥5,175,679 thousand (up 4.4% year on year), but the company recorded an operating loss of ¥234,470 thousand.
